title: Fleet Task Card
description: One task card per file under tasks/. Machine-readable, PR-gated. Status drives the shared board (backlog -> claimed -> in_progress -> pr -> done).

id.description: Fleet task id, e.g. FLT-001. Must match the filename.

owner.description: Single owning agent (collaboration rule: one task, one owner).

depends_on.description: Task ids this card depends on.

rate_card_ref.description: Rate card version (e.g. v0.1.0) that prices this task's completion. Null until rates are set.

banana_value.description: Bananas earned on verified completion (derived from rate card; null until rates are set by khalid).

definition.description: What 'completed well' means for THIS task (pipeline artifact or task-specific).

evidence.description: Verifiable evidence types, e.g. merged-pr, review-approval, qa-verify.
